operations.command: mkdir -p '.vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}' && nix-build tests/sleep-lock/restart-control --arg patched {{patched}} --arg video {{video}} --no-out-link --cores 4 --max-jobs 1 > '.vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}/test.log' 2>&1 || { tail -70 '.vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}/test.log'; exit 1; }
